name: agent-context-router
description: MCP server that loads AGENTS.md instructions on demand. Keep the rules that apply every turn in a slim AGENTS.md and load the rest from git-backed modules when the agent reaches the work their triggers name. Includes a migrate command that splits an existing AGENTS.md with backups, a guided review and a one-step restore.

env.name: AGENT_MACHINE
env.description: Machine profile, work or personal. Defaults to ~/.agent-machine, then work

env.name: ACR_SYNC_WINDOW
env.description: Seconds between fetches of the same repo. Defaults to 1800
